title: K’ari pesajenak contra aru
intro: Mä chiqa chuyman almaw aljirinakampi aljirinakampix jilsuwayxi, kawkhantix balanzas ukanakax inclinatäna ukat medidas ukanakax jisk’aptayatänwa. Uka jaqejj sapakiw mä markan jan honradöpjjatap contra saytʼasïna, cheqapar sarnaqapjjañapatakiw jawsäna, ukat mä sapa Cheqpach Diosar yupaychapjjañapatakiw jawsäna. Yatiyäwix qhanäkchïnsa ukat jawsatax chiqapar uñjatäkchïnsa, jaqinakax janiw istʼañ munapkänti ukat mä jan waltʼäwiruw puripxäna. ¿Quran tuqit aka jach’a yatiyirirux uñt’asmati?
clues: Mä yatiyirit khithapxitäna, jupanakan jakawipax aljasiñampi, aljasiñampiw muyuntata.
Markajajj oraqpachanwa mä jukʼa medida churatapata ukat pesonak sallqjatapat uñtʼatäpjjäna.
Ukat thakin sarnaqirinakarus axsarayasaw jan walinak aka Uraqpachar yatiyapxäna.
Allah saparuki yupaychapxañapataki ukat mayninakamp sum apasiñatakis taqpach chiqapar sarnaqapxañapatakiw achiktʼayäta.
Nayan yatiyatajarojj janiw istʼapkänti, nayarusa, nayamp chik iyawsirinakarus uka oraqet jaqunukuñwa ajjsarayapjjarakitäna.
Allah jupax khuyapayasiñapampiw nayaru ukhamarak arkirinakajarux qhispiyawayitu, jan wali luririnakax mä jan walt’ayir castigompiw katuntatäpxäna.

trial.label: Markajan Juchapa
options: Alaxpachar uñtat mä jach’a torre luraña
Mä qalat mä camello warmi mayiña

outcome.label: Jupanakan Tukuyäwipa
options: Mä ch’allxtayiri jach’a arumax jupanakarux katjataynawa
Mä jachʼa umajj taqeniruw umamp chhaqtayäna
Mä jachʼa thaya thayaw jupanakar tʼunjäna
Tʼantʼat lurat laqʼa qalanakaw jupanakar jalluntäna
outcome.answer: Mä ch’allxtayiri jach’a arumax jupanakarux katjataynawa

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
